name: Jenni Kayne

craft_evidence.owned: no — none stated; the about page covers the brand's world, not its making
craft_evidence.mills: no — fabric and fibre origins are placed, not named ('Made in Turkey of Italian fabric', 'Mongolian and Inner Mongolian cashmere', 'Donegal cashmere', 'Suri alpaca')
craft_evidence.madein: 73 of 74 state a country: China 42, Peru 9, Turkey 8, USA 6, Italy 3, Vietnam 3, Morocco 1, Mexico 1
craft_evidence.heritage: NC — no founding date or place found on /pages/about (Oak Essentials and the brand world only); /pages/our-story 404
craft_evidence.process: no — one denim line notes 'seeded denim, a minimally processed material'
craft_evidence.reasoning: Nearly every page states the country, and many name the fabric's or fibre's origin (Italian fabric, Mongolian cashmere, Peruvian alpaca), but no maker, mill or facility is named.
